name: loadboot-ios
description: LoadBoot iOS shell (Capacitor 8). Loads https://loadboot.com/app/ in an app-bound WKWebView and bridges APNs push, camera, GPS, deep links and the system browser. The web app itself lives in ../../app and deploys via Netlify — this shell only changes when native code changes.

scripts.ios:prepare: npm run ios:add && npm run ios:config && npm run assets && npm run ios:sync
